svg.title: The model answers before the creator acts
svg.desc: Keep the creator's input field empty while the model response appears. Speed and interface position show who answers first without converting the response into authoritative adjudication.

Speed and interface position show who answers first without converting the response into authoritative adjudication.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "location-background-curt-home-office", "box": [ 0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.96 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "blank-monitor", "box": [ 0.2148, 0.1282, 0.5336, 0.3968 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "CHATGPT", "label_box": [ 0.20679999999999998, 0.531, 0.5496, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "hero", "source": "
**Location:** `curt-home-office`

**Frame:** ChatGPT's window answers first, quickly, in its usual clean block. Curt has not typed anything.

**Screen / system text — CHATGPT:**
> The wipe still separates them. Nothing survived the rebuild, so the second board had to be found again from scratch. That part of the argument holds.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` — dramatized model output, stated confidently and, on the next panel, wrongly.
